name: PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS)
metaTitle: PostgreSQL Row-Level Security for Multi-Tenant SaaS
description: Techlio implements database-enforced tenant isolation using PostgreSQL RLS to prevent cross-customer data leakage across multi-tenant SaaS and RAG applications.
answer: Row-Level Security is a PostgreSQL feature that makes the database itself decide which rows each user or tenant can see. Techlio uses it in multi-tenant SaaS and RAG systems so that a bug in application code cannot expose one customer's data to another.

builds.title: Tenant isolation
builds.text: Policies that restrict every query to the current tenant, tested with automated checks.

builds.title: Secure RAG retrieval
builds.text: Vector and keyword search that returns only documents the current user may read.

builds.title: Audits and retrofits
builds.text: Review of an existing schema and staged introduction of policies without downtime.

fits: AI retrieval must respect document permissions

faqs.question: Does RLS slow the database down?
faqs.answer: With sensible indexes the cost is small. We measure it on your workload.

faqs.question: Can RLS be added to an existing product?
faqs.answer: Yes, table by table, with tests proving each policy before it is enforced.
